locator.section: 14 January, Holy Name Postcommunion; name and predestination clause

entries.claim: Historical interpretive support for reading titulo in apposition to the name of Jesus: the older wording calls that name a pledge of eternal predestination. The current sign wording is a revision against the Latin, not an exact quotation or an assertion that this is the only possible attachment. The older date and abbreviated conclusion are not adopted as 1962 calendar or full-ending evidence.

locator.section: The Most Holy Name of Jesus, Postcommunion body

entries.claim: Primary historical English basis, revised against the Latin in contemporary language. The creation, redemption, offering, infused grace and heavenly inscription clauses are retained in revised wording. The name/title interpretation is separately supported by the earlier historical use. This page has only Through the same, &c., not the full expanded conclusion, and is not evidence for the 1962 calendar placement.

locator.section: Libera nos, expanded conclusion and duration

entries.claim: Historical basis for the expanded conclusion and duration, revised for the selected Latin: same is retained and our is supplied for nostrum; address and Holy Spirit terminology are modernized. World without end is rendered forever and ever. This is the formula in Libera nos, not the abbreviated Holy Name Postcommunion ending printed in full.
